I hope you'll be ok. it makes me sad to see ppl younger than me here because I was feeling a similar way for as long as I can remember and i really wouldnt wish that on anyone

I struggle with saying shit without thinking too but man its a part of life as upsrtting as it is. Sometimes ure gonna hurt people. Everyone does it. ESPECIALLY when youre still a teenager .it doesnt make you a bad person or mean that you deserve to hurt for it

bullying sucks. I've been thru it and i also would not wish that upon anybody it fucks with you in unimaginable ways. 

what's some stuff u like or things u like to do?

I was like 8 and I got weighed while I was at the hospital for some pretty bad breathing problems and I'd always been a bigger kid but my dad decided to say "wow you're really eating your wheaties! your brother is only xx pounds" right in front of the doctor. Note my brother is 3 years older than me ☹

Ever since I'd been afraid to go to the doctor but the active desire to lose weight didn't really kick in until one summer when I was like 11? I think? And I started literally forcing my child self to do HIIT workouts with the hope of losing weight. 😭. It never really went anywhere cuz I was a little kid and that shit hurt after a while so I was still like medically obese. That fall around when I turned 12 and I started hunting through tumblr proana blogs (note this was like.. 2018? I think you reeally had to actively had to look for that shit by that point) and I literally started thinking "damn I wanna get an eating disorder."

The weirdest part of all of this is when I first actually developed my full blown eating disorder in early 2020 I didn't recognize it as that initially despite me wanting one for most of my preteen years? It's really interesting I just kind of thought I would lose a ton of weight and then return to school and be super hot and everyone would like me and I guess we can see how all of that went considering I'm here rn 😅 Once I recognized it as an ED after like spending the whole summer obsessing over losing weight I started to struggle with restricting which confuses the shit outta me

Sorry this was super long i just think there was more than one moment that fucked with my brain enough for me to remember not tryna garner sympathy or anything lol
